== 描述 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom 信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>{{Episode
 | title             = 
 | partOfSeason      = 
 | episodeNumber     = 
 | image             = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | airDate           = 
 | writer            = 
 | director          = 
 | previousEpisode   = 
 | nextEpisode       = 
}}</pre>

== 示例输出 ==
{{Episode
 | title             = 巴别之花
 | partOfSeason      = 1
 | episodeNumber     = 3
 | image             = Example.jpg
 | airDate           = 未播出
 | writer            = D. Righta
 | director          = A. di Rektour
 | previousEpisode   = 第二集
 | nextEpisode       = 第四集
}}<pre>{{Episode
 | title             = 巴别之花
 | partOfSeason      = 1
 | episodeNumber     = 3
 | image             = Example.jpg
 | airDate           = 未播出
 | writer            = D. Righta
 | director          = A. di Rektour
 | previousEpisode   = 第二集
 | nextEpisode       = 第四集
}}</pre>
